body.statement: Under the two simplex restrictions, \(\mathcal Q(o,e)\neq\varnothing\) if and only if \(e_{is}\geq o_{is}\) for every \(i\in\mathcal X\) and \(s\in\mathcal Y\).
body.justification: This isolates the complete observable feasibility condition and rules out hidden cross-coordinate restrictions before sharpness is studied.
body.gap: Shu--Wang--Li use the same consistency-implied cell inequalities, but the categorical sufficiency construction is not their all-dimensional sharpness theorem.
body.consumer: A researcher can reject incoherent observational and intervention margins before evaluating any conjunction bound.
